command:
printf 'NS_DIRECTORY
'; ls -ld /proc/self/ns /proc/self/ns/net /proc/1/ns/net 2>&1
printf '
NAMESPACE_APPLETS
'; /opt/bin/busybox --list | /opt/bin/busybox grep -E '^(unshare|nsenter|timeout|readlink|ip)$'
printf '
KERNEL_CONFIG
'; if [ -r /proc/config.gz ]; then /opt/bin/busybox zcat /proc/config.gz | /opt/bin/busybox grep -E '^(CONFIG_(NAMESPACES|NET_NS|USER_NS|UTS_NS|IPC_NS|PID_NS|VETH|TUN|IP_MULTIPLE_TABLES|IP_ROUTE_MULTIPATH|NETFILTER|NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_TPROXY|NETFILTER_XT_MATCH_MARK|NETFILTER_XT_TARGET_MARK|NF_TPROXY_IPV4|NF_TABLES)=|# CONFIG_(NET_NS|NAMESPACES|VETH|TUN) is not set)'; else printf 'config_unavailable
'; fi
stdout:

ip
readlink
